The design of the project and the selection of the lt/spangtltspangtAoIlt/spangtltspangt were also informed by extensive ad-hoc evaluation and assessment activities conducted by the IPs (see section 2.4).lt/spangtlt/spangtltspangt lt/spangtlt/pgtlt/divgtltdivgtltpgtltugtltspangtltspangtUnder lt/spangtlt/spangtltspangtltspangtPillar 1lt/spangtlt/spangtlt/ugtltspangtltspangt, the project will adopt a mixed assistance modality, with the provision of weekly in-kind fresh food baskets and vouchers for dry food to 850 households (HHs) for a total of 5,100 individuals material and technical support to 200 small-scale farmers (targeting a total of 1,200 farmers’ HH members) provision of Menstrual Hygiene (MH) vouchers to 1,525 vulnerable girls and women support to 60 HHs with Supplementary Subsistence Gardens as pilot exit strategy to food assistance.lt/spangtlt/spangtltspangtlt/spangtlt/pgtlt/divgtltdivgtltpgtltugtltspangtltspangtUnder lt/spangtlt/spangtltspangtltspangtPillar 3lt/spangtlt/spangtlt/ugtltspangtltspangt, WW-GVC will provide organizational capacity building to 15 individuals from Mada staff on Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) procurement safety and security Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) and Safeguarding. In addition, WW-GVC will organize two thematic roundtables on MEAL and AAP with a total of 40 LHF and IPs representatives, to discuss and collect best practices and lessons learnt to inform future LHF localized and accountable humanitarian responses.lt/spangtlt/spangtltspangt lt/spangtlt/pgtlt/divgtltdivgtltpgtltspangtltspangtltbrgtThe selection of beneficiaries of FS and WASH assistance will be conducted through participatory consultations with community representatives, local authorities, and other local actors to identify vulnerable HHs.
